# Research Question

Does having more police officers on college campuses lead to lower reported crime rates?

# Project Background

For my final project, I want to examine whether the number of police officers at a college or university is related to the amount of crime reported on campus.

I am interested in this topic because campus safety is important, and universities have different levels of police presence. I want to see whether colleges with more campus police officers tend to have lower reported crime rates.

# Research Hypothesis

My hypothesis is that colleges with more campus police officers per student will have lower reported violent crime rates than colleges with fewer officers per student.

# Data Sources

I plan to use two main sources:

1. The U.S. Department of Education's Campus Safety and Security data.
   https://ope.ed.gov/campussafety/

2. The Bureau of Justice Statistics' Survey of Campus Law Enforcement Agencies.
   https://bjs.ojp.gov/

# Data Exploration

I will load and examine my datasets in this section.

# Important Variables

I plan to examine the number of campus police officers, reported violent crimes, student enrollment, institution identification numbers, and reporting years.

# Missing Information and Limitations

I will examine missing values and determine whether both datasets contain information for the same colleges and reporting periods.
